operators.name: adaptive_avg_pool1d

parameters.name: input
parameters.shape: same as reference step input [batch, in_features, seq_len]

returns.shape: same as reference step output [batch, in_features, output_size]

semantics: Compute adaptive average pooling over last dimension of input tensor.
Pooling windows are calculated per PyTorch AdaptiveAvgPool1d semantics: start = floor(i * L / output_size), end = ceil((i+1) * L / output_size).
Each output element is the average of input[start:end] along the last dimension.
Apply AdaptiveAvgPool1d with output_size=64 on input x of shape [128,128,24576].
Result shape [128,128,64], dtype float32, on CUDA.
